name: Community Theater Operations
audience: community theaters and volunteer-led stage-production teams

products.name: Rehearsal Conflict Resolution
products.product: A focused community theater rehearsal conflict tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community theaters and volunteer-led stage-production teams
products.problem: Cast and crew availability, scene requirements, music or fight calls, room access, volunteer schedules, and newly added conflicts cause calendar changes that do not reach everyone affected.
products.valueProposition: Turns community theater rehearsal conflict tracking into a visible operating queue so every material rehearsal conflict is resolved against scene and role dependencies, published as one current schedule, and acknowledged by affected participants.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets theater rehearsal scheduling, cast availability tracker, community theater software, and rehearsal conflict management searches.

products.name: Production Asset Return
products.product: A focused theater prop and costume return tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community theaters and volunteer-led stage-production teams
products.problem: Props, costumes, wigs, scripts, keys, microphones, tools, and borrowed items leave storage with cast or departments, then strike and return status disappear across paper sign-outs.
products.valueProposition: Turns theater prop and costume return tracking into a visible operating queue so every production asset has assigned custody, condition evidence, return deadline, storage destination, and an explicit lost damage repair or closed outcome.
products.topic: theater prop and costume return tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets theater prop tracking, costume inventory software, community theater asset checkout, and theater strike checklist searches.
